title: AP Chemistry Independent Foundation Pilot
description: An independently authored 360-question AP Chemistry foundation pilot spanning all nine current units. It tests the blueprint crosswalk, six chemistry science practices, quantitative routines, model analysis, laboratory reasoning, structured native chapters, and internal QA before any release-ready expansion.
disclaimer: Independent, unofficial AP Chemistry preparation material for internal foundation-pilot development only. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or authored by College Board. This pilot does not provide official scores, score predictions, college-credit predictions, laboratory competency, or a substitute for supervised laboratory work.
contentReview: Three hundred sixty original source-aligned draft multiple-choice items distributed evenly across all nine current AP Chemistry units, with all six science practices represented, topic remediation routes, quantitative routines, laboratory reasoning, and nine structured native lessons. Independent AP Chemistry subject-expert, laboratory, rights, accessibility, production, field-testing, and psychometric review remain pending.

bigIdeas.label: Structure of Matter

bigIdeas.description: Chemical reactions involve rearrangements of atoms and changes in energy and matter.

bigIdeas.description: Energy changes and entropy help determine the favorability of processes.

bigIdeas.label: Equilibrium

bigIdeas.label: Acids and Bases
